description: §22.4.1 (S458 "your recs on all four", item 3) — the `data-scrml-` attribute namespace is compiler-owned. A compile-time `emit()` whose output carries `DATA-SCRML-OUTLET="x"` (upper case: the HTML tokenizer folds it to `data-scrml-outlet`) is refused with E-META-EVAL-002 by the same reader that judges the rest of emit() output.
rationale: §22.4.1: "An attribute in `emit()` / `emit.raw()` output whose name begins with `data-scrml-` SHALL be `E-META-EVAL-002` … ASCII upper case folded to lower case".
